title: KYC Mismatch — Name
description: The name in your PF account does not match the name in your Aadhaar/PAN records.

title: KYC Mismatch — Date of Birth
description: Your date of birth in PF records does not match your Aadhaar/PAN.

title: KYC Mismatch — Father's Name
description: Father's name in PF records differs from your KYC documents.

title: Bank Account Not Verified
description: The bank account linked to your PF is not verified or does not match your name.

title: Aadhaar Not Seeded
description: Your Aadhaar number is not linked (seeded) to your UAN.

title: PAN Not Verified
description: Your PAN card is either not linked or the details don't match with EPFO records.

title: Employer Attestation Pending
description: Your employer has not attested/approved your claim. They need to sign off on it.

title: Insufficient Service Period
description: You haven't completed the minimum required service period for this type of withdrawal.

title: Duplicate Claim
description: A claim for this purpose has already been submitted and is being processed.

title: Form Incomplete
description: Required fields in your claim form are missing or incomplete.

title: Wrong Form Type
description: The form submitted does not match the purpose of withdrawal. E.g., Form 31 used instead of Form 19.

title: Member ID Mismatch
description: The Member ID on the form doesn't match the records for this UAN.

title: Employer Establishment Inactive
description: The employer's EPFO establishment code is deactivated or non-compliant.

title: Advance Limit Exceeded
description: The advance amount requested exceeds the permissible limit for this withdrawal type.

title: Previous Advance Not Settled
description: A previously sanctioned advance has not been settled/utilized. New advance cannot be processed.

title: Nominee Details Missing
description: Nominee/family details are not updated in your EPFO records.

title: Transfer Not Complete
description: A pending PF transfer from a previous employer has not been completed.

title: Age Criteria Not Met
description: You do not meet the age requirement for pension withdrawal (Form 10C/10D).

title: Contribution Discrepancy
description: There is a mismatch between employer-reported contributions and EPFO records.

title: IFSC Code Invalid
description: The IFSC code of the linked bank account is invalid or the branch has been merged.

title: Cheque/Passbook Not Uploaded
description: Cancelled cheque or bank passbook copy was not attached with the claim.

title: Employment Certificate Missing
description: Certificate of employment/cessation from employer is required but not provided.

title: COVID Advance Already Availed
description: The COVID-19 special advance has already been availed and cannot be claimed again.

title: Joint Declaration Pending
description: A joint declaration from you and your employer is required for service period correction.

title: Digital Signature Verification Failed
description: The digital signature on the online claim could not be verified.
